Posted September 28, 2007 

Analysis by Richard Cowan  

cowan@MarijuanaNews.com 

  

Todays Ontario, California-based Daily Bulletin has an op-ed, Medical marijuana, a decoy in effort to legalize all drugs, by Brenda Chabot, the head of a local prohibitionist propaganda organization called the Inland Valley Drug Free Community Coalition. 

 

As its title suggests, for a connoisseur of the prohibitionist party line, it is just a stroll down memory lane.  

See

Reading Between The Lies. New Version of An Old Lie About My Saying Medical Cannabis Is A Scam May Be Clue to New Prohibitionist Party Line. Only A Few Hundred Patients?

   

There is not one point that Ms Chabot makes that has not been exhaustively covered on MarijuanaNews.com and other anti-prohibitionist websites. Not that she would know that, which is the real subject at hand. 

 

For example, Ms Chabot tells us,

The Institute of Medicine conducted a comprehensive study in 1999 to assess the potential health benefits of marijuana and its constituent cannabinoids. The study concluded that smoking marijuana is not recommended for the treatment of any disease condition. In addition, there are more effective medications currently available. For those reasons, the Institute of Medicine concluded that there is little future in smoked marijuana as a medically approved medication.

Of course, it is obvious that she has never actually read the actual IOM report, or she would know that it really said, There is no clear alternative for people suffering from chronic conditions that might be relieved by smoking marijuana, such as pain or AIDS wasting.
See


Executive Summary Of The IOM Report, Marijuana And Medicine: Assessing The Science Base 

Nor could she know that cannabis need not be smoked.

See

No Medicine Is Smoked. Okay, But Why Isnt Cannabis Sold Over-the-Counter? New MAPS/NORML Vaporizer Study Undermines Key Part Of Prohibitionist Party Line On Smoked-Marijuana.
and 

Prohibitionism After the IOM Report; Analysis by Richard Cowan

Repeat After Me: No Medicine Is Smoked! No Medicine Is Smoked! No Medicine Is Smoked!Thats It. You Are Now Qualified To Start Your Very Own Government Funded Anti-Drug Group!  

Instead, she is simply repeating what the Drug Czar said that it said, which is typical of most anti-drug activists, and most of the media. 

See 

Washington Post and New York Times on IOM Medical Marijuana  

Compare and Contrast A Split In The Establishment?  

The Drug Czars Quote In The Post Wins The Prize. 

and 

And The Czar Keeps Lying About His Own Report.   

and

 Column By Authors of the IOM Report On Medical Marijuana

Shows Why The Public Does Not Trust The Medical Establishment

And Why They Should Not! With Analysis by Richard Cowan 

The First Anniversary of the IOM Report And The Lies and Hatred Continue, Business As Usual. Analysis By Richard Cowan  

But why?  

 

I have written about what I call the prohibitionist paradigm, which keeps people from seeing what they do not want to see about the marijuana prohibition. There is a famous drawing that is an optical illusion that appears to be either a beautiful young woman or a very old woman, depending on the perception of the viewer. After someone points out the other view, both become obvious.  

 

That phenomenon is called paradigm blindness and it works at the abstract level as well. As Einstein said, It is the theory which decides what we can observe.

See  

 Bennett, Limbaugh, and the Blindness of the Prohibitionist Paradigm.

For example, most prohibitionists simply cannot conceive of the idea that legalizing drugs would not lead to a vast increase in the rate of use, or that the government would not permit medical cannabis if there really were a need for it. 

See 

More Proof That The Drug War Is Really A War On Cannabis. Plus: Sabotaging Medical Cannabis Research And Lying About It. Analysis by Richard Cowan  

 

To the prohibitionist true believer like Ms Chabot, medical marijuana must just be a decoy or red herring. But does she know the history of the use of the term red herring in this context, or that it is still on the California Narcotics Officers Association web site? 

See 

 

The Use of Marijuana as Medicine 

I put that link there because the old one was changed and I want everyone, including prohibitionists like Ms Chabot, to know what the prohibitionist party line is. 

Also see 

Lies Have Consequences. From Prohibitionist Venom to the Harsh Realities of Life and Death for Patients. Swedish Prohibitionists, Canadian Bureaucracy and DEAland Medical Murder.  

Of course, she could just be as dishonest as Cliff Kincaid or Eric Voth. 

See

More Stupid Prohibitionist Tricks: Orwell Died Before Cliff Kincaid Was Born, But He Knew Him All Too Well.  

and

The Prohibitionist True Believers Explain What The IOM Report Said --

"Marijuana Causes Health Problems" 

But, for rhetorical purposes, lets give her the benefit of the doubt. 

 

How does someone live in the same world as the Netherlands and not know that the Dutch have a lower rate of cannabis use and a much lover rate of hard drug use than the US, UK, Canada, etc? 

See

International Prohibition Situation Report DEAland Media Ignore News Showing Cannabis Prohibition Is Counterproductive. Coffee Shop System Survives.

And how does someone live in a state where there are hundreds of thousands of medical marijuana users conclude that it has no medical value? How does someone ignore the harm caused by the laws? 

See 

Prophylactic State Violence: The Arrogance and Ignorance of Psychiatric Quackery. Bad Science, Worse Ethics -- Analysis by Richard Cowan  

It is simple: Avoid reading anything that contradicts ones ideology. But it cant be easy in todays world. 

 

Not too long ago I came across the wonderful phrase, incestuous amplification.

It is defined as The reinforcement of set beliefs among like-minded people, leading to miscalculations and errors in judgment. 

 

Interestingly, the earliest citation of the phrase was One immutable law of Pentagon force planning is that the Joint Chiefs of Staff will generate requirements greater than the existing force, irrespective of the strategy in vogue at the time. It is the inevitable result of a cycle that a former officer calls ''incestuous amplification.'' 

David Evans, "A runaway Pentagon," The New York Times, October 3, 1984  

From http://www.wordspy.com/words/incestuousamplification.asp 

 

Also: 

Without knowing it, the Columbia investigators were identifying a pervasive social problem, one that unites these examples and that leads to many failures in the public and private sectors. Among psychologists, it is known as "group polarization."  

and 

Like-minded people, talking only with one another, usually end up believing a more extreme version of what they thought before they started to talk. 

Cass R. Sunstein, "The Power of Dissent," Los Angeles Times, September 17, 2003  

 

As I have pointed out in the past, most prohibitionist websites do not have any links to anti-prohibitionist sites, whereas we really want people to know just what the prohibitionists are saying. That is why I published a link to the Daily Bulletin Op-ed and Ms Chabots website, where you will find only links to other prohibitionist propaganda sites. 

 

By contrast, I spend a good part of my day reading things that I disagree with. In fact, I am almost pleased when I find a new lie. 

See

Walters Tells a New Lie. Oh Happy Day! People Need Treatment If They Are Sent to Treatment, By Definition. And How Do They Treat Marijuana Addicts? We Couldnt Make This Up, But They Did.  

But it isnt so easy being a prohibitionist. In order to protect their certainty, prohibitionists generally must avoid debating us, which is just as well, because their self-imposed isolation greatly undermines their debating skills.  

 

They get up and brilliantly refute things that we have not said. Good lawyers point out that one should never ask a witness a question without knowing what the answer will be. Prohibitionists are quite literally clueless. 

 

However, I am sending a link to this posting to Ms Chabot and I am sure that after reading it and exploring the links, she will quit her job and join NORML.  

 

But I dont think that I will wait to exhale.
